cases.title: stack（默认）：组内按 -group 累加，第一个 group 在最上面
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col()

cases.title: stack(reverse = TRUE)：组内按 group 正序累加
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE))

cases.title: stack：负值单独向下堆（ymin/ymax 是相邻累计高度的 min/max）
cases.code: ggplot(negative, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col()

cases.title: fill：stack 之后每个 x 归一到 0..1
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = 'fill')

cases.title: dodge：两组柱并排（width 缺省取柱子宽度，xmin/xmax 由 d_width / n 决定）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge())

cases.title: dodge(preserve = 'single')：n 取所有 x 上的最大组数（不均匀分组）
cases.code: ggplot(uneven, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = 'single'))

cases.title: dodge2：按重叠的 x 区间分组 + padding（n 取自每个重叠组）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2())

cases.title: dodge2(padding = 0.2)：柱宽按 (1 - padding) 缩进
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2(padding = 0.2))

cases.title: dodge2(preserve = 'single') 且 data 没有 x：n 取 find_x_overlaps 的重叠组数
cases.code: ggplot(rects, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = g)) + geom_rect(position = position_dodge2(preserve = 'single'))

cases.title: 横向 dodge（flipped_aes = TRUE）：位移作用在 y 上，x 是长度
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y', position = position_dodge())

cases.title: 横向 stack（flipped_aes = TRUE）：累计值落在 x 族（长度轴），y 仍是类别轴
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y')

cases.title: 横向 fill（flipped_aes = TRUE）：归一后的 y 族写回 x 族，y 保持类别
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y', position = 'fill')

cases.title: jitter(seed = 42)：缺省 width/height = 40% resolution（值依赖 R 的 RNG）
cases.code: ggplot(points, aes(x, y)) + geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 42))

cases.title: nudge(x = 0.2, y = 1)：x / y 族整体平移
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_nudge(x = 0.2, y = 1))

cases.title: dodge2(preserve = 'total')：不均匀分组时 n 取每个重叠组的行数
cases.code: ggplot(uneven, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2())

cases.title: dodge2(preserve = 'single', padding = 0.2)：n 取全层最大组数 3
cases.code: ggplot(uneven, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = 'single', padding = 0.2))

cases.title: geom_boxplot 的默认 position_dodge2：箱宽 0.75，两组并排后叠 padding
cases.code: ggplot(box_data, aes(factor(x), y, fill = g)) + geom_boxplot()

cases.title: geom_boxplot(varwidth = TRUE)：箱宽 ∝ sqrt(n)，position 自动换成 preserve = 'single'
cases.code: ggplot(box_data, aes(factor(x), y, fill = g)) + geom_boxplot(varwidth = TRUE)

cases.title: 横向 dodge2（flipped_aes = TRUE）：并排作用在 y 族，长度轴 x 不动
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y', position = position_dodge2())

cases.title: jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0)：零抖动退化成 dodge（dodge.width = 0.75）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, group = g)) + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, jitter.height = 0, seed = 42))

cases.title: jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.4)：dodge 相位用 0.4，jitter.width = 0
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, group = g)) + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.4, seed = 42))

cases.title: jitterdodge(reverse = TRUE)：pos_dodge() 不看 reverse，输出与正向逐值相等
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, group = g)) + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, jitter.height = 0, seed = 42, reverse = TRUE))

cases.title: jitterdodge()：jitter.width 缺省 = 40% resolution / (ndodge + 2) = 0.1，只抖 x
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, group = g)) + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(seed = 42))

cases.title: jitterdodge 分面：每面板各自并排（jitter.width = 0，seed 无关）
cases.code: ggplot(faceted, aes(x, y, group = g)) + geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, jitter.height = 0)) + facet_wrap(~f)

cases.title: geom_text 的默认 position 是 nudge；没有 nudge_x / nudge_y 时两列补 0
cases.code: ggplot(text_data, aes(x, y, label = lab)) + geom_text()

cases.title: geom_text(nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -0.1)：图层参数经 use_defaults 落成 nudge 列
cases.code: ggplot(text_data, aes(x, y, label = lab)) + geom_text(nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -0.1)

cases.title: geom_text(aes(nudge_y = c(-0.1, 0.1)))：逐行的 nudge 列
cases.code: ggplot(text_data, aes(x, y, label = lab)) + geom_text(aes(nudge_y = c(-0.1, 0.1)))

cases.title: position_nudge(x = c(0.1, 0.2))：逐行向量（长度 = 行数）
cases.code: ggplot(text_data, aes(x, y, label = lab)) + geom_text(position = position_nudge(x = c(0.1, 0.2)))

cases.title: stack × facet_wrap：每个面板各自从 0 累加（不跨面板叠）
cases.code: ggplot(faceted, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col() + facet_wrap(~f)

cases.title: dodge × facet_wrap：每面板各自并排，order 仍按 (x, PANEL) 取名次
cases.code: ggplot(faceted, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = 'dodge') + facet_wrap(~f)

cases.title: dodge2(preserve = 'single') × facet_wrap：n = 全层最大值 3（不是逐面板 2）
cases.code: ggplot(faceted_uneven, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = 'single')) + facet_wrap(~f)

cases.title: jitter × facet_wrap：seed 每面板重置，两个面板的偏移相同（值依赖 R 的 RNG）
cases.code: ggplot(faceted, aes(x, y)) + geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 42)) + facet_wrap(~f)

cases.title: identity：位置列原样返回（geom_col 的 position 不改任何列）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = 'identity')
